mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the average 20-day return in such instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.35 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressure, which triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1350.0, or the average 60-day return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 102.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which signals an impending economic slowdown and reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 102.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both consumer spending (RSAFS) and residential construction (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand and rising inflation expectations, which triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST are above their 90th percentiles, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 313.5 combined with a federal funds rate above 5.0% indicates a high-inflation, restrictive policy regime that compresses equity risk premiums and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 313.5 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 4.3% and a rise in nonfarm payrolls above 158,700 thousand signals a rapidly tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both UNRATE < 4.3 and PAYEMS > 158700, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.5% annualized combined with rising residential construction (HOUST) above 1.35 million units signals a strong late-cycle expansion with rising inflationary pressures, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to anticipated monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 > 2.5 and HOUST > 1350.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
